# meltcloud_nest_instance (Data Source)

A host added to the Nest as [Nest Instance](https://docs.meltcloud.io/tasks/nest/create-instance). Needs the API Key of the admin Organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# the instance the nest was installed on
data "meltcloud_nest_instance" "first" {
  name = "nest-0"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) Internal ID of the Nest Instance on meltcloud
- `name` (String) Host name of the Nest Instance, unique within the Nest

### Read-Only

- `architecture` (String) CPU architecture the instance reported
- `bgp` (Attributes) BGP peering of the instance. Null when the Nest does not use BGP (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--bgp))
- `boot_disk` (Attributes) The boot disk of the instance (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--boot_disk))
- `etcd_disk` (Attributes) The disk etcd is kept on (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--etcd_disk))
- `ip_addresses` (Attributes List) The addresses of the instance, one per IP Pool of its Network Profile (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ip_addresses))
- `nest_id` (Number) ID of the Nest the instance belongs to
- `network_profile_id` (Number) ID of the [Network Profile](https://docs.meltcloud.io/concepts/networking/network-profiles) the instance uses
- `status` (String) Status of the instance: `installing` until it has joined the Nest, then `ready`. `boot_failed` if it reported a failed boot; see [Troubleshoot](https://docs.meltcloud.io/tasks/nest/troubleshoot#joining). A reset instance is `removed` until it installs again
- `version` (String) Nest version the instance runs
- `zone_id` (Number) ID of the [Zone](https://docs.meltcloud.io/concepts/regions-and-zones) the instance is in

<a id="nestedatt--bgp"></a>
### Nested Schema for `bgp`

Read-Only:

- `local_asn` (Number) ASN of the instance
- `peers` (Attributes List) The BGP peers of the instance, without their passwords (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--bgp--peers))

<a id="nestedatt--bgp--peers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `bgp.peers`

Read-Only:

- `asn` (Number) ASN of the peer
- `bfd` (Attributes) BFD on the session. Null when BFD is off (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--bgp--peers--bfd))
- `ip` (String) IP address of the peer
- `multihop` (Boolean) Whether the peer is more than one hop away

<a id="nestedatt--bgp--peers--bfd"></a>
### Nested Schema for `bgp.peers.bfd`

Read-Only:

- `detect_multiplier` (Number) Detect multiplier
- `receive_interval` (Number) Receive interval in milliseconds
- `transmit_interval` (Number) Transmit interval in milliseconds




<a id="nestedatt--boot_disk"></a>
### Nested Schema for `boot_disk`

Read-Only:

- `device` (String) Device the OS is installed to
- `mirror` (Boolean) Whether the boot disk is mirrored
- `mirror_device` (String) Device the boot disk is mirrored to


<a id="nestedatt--etcd_disk"></a>
### Nested Schema for `etcd_disk`

Read-Only:

- `device` (String) Device etcd is kept on
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether etcd is kept on a disk of its own
- `mirror` (Boolean) Whether the etcd disk is mirrored
- `mirror_device` (String) Device the etcd disk is mirrored to


<a id="nestedatt--ip_addresses"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ip_addresses`

Read-Only:

- `address` (String) The address
- `ip_pool_id` (Number) ID of the IP Pool
- `static` (Boolean) Whether it is a [static IP](https://docs.meltcloud.io/concepts/networking/subnet-addressing#static-ip-addresses) rather than one the pool allocated
